title: All 15 scenarios passed
summary: All 15 Webots integration scenarios passed (15/15, 100%). The CI exercised builtin file operations, plan control, camera/lidar snapshots, explore, mapping, memory, scene, speech, voiceprint, and multi-step flow scenarios. No regressions were introduced by the PR changes.
pr_changes: Added new system/vitals crate with health monitoring, module health polling, Soma ingestion, mock Soma, and threshold evaluation
Added health-related IDL messages and services under capabilities/lib/health, module_health, soma, and vitals
Added module health gRPC endpoints to executor and pilot (get_health)
Added health streaming and get_health capabilities to Soma
Added new Cargo workspace member system/vitals and updated Makefile
Updated Cargo.lock with new dependencies (approx, chacha20, defmt, env_logger, jiff, etc.)
Added Python bridge scripts for Piper and Koch arm hardware
Added threshold YAML configuration and test fixtures for Vitals
test_result: 15 scenarios passed: builtin/fault_recovery_builtin, builtin/file_roundtrip, builtin/plan_control_builtins, builtin/run_command, cap/camera_snapshot, cap/explore_smoke, cap/lidar_snapshot, cap/mapping_save, cap/memory_roundtrip, cap/scene_object_fixture, cap/speech_speak, cap/voiceprint_list, flow/fault_recovery, flow/object_navigation, flow/patrol_observe. All exercised capabilities returned expected results.
suggested_fix: No fix needed. The new Vitals crate and health capabilities are not yet exercised by CI scenarios; consider adding a Vitals smoke test in a follow-up PR.
